name: Alpen Bitcoin Dollar
oneLiner: BTD is Alpen’s planned BTC-only dollar debt token built from Liquity V2, with deployed oracle, bridge and liquidation details unverified.
collateral: Pre-launch: BTC is the sole announced collateral for an overcollateralized Liquity V2-derived debt system on Alpen’s Bitcoin ZK rollup. No deployed collateral/liability ratio, reserve conservation or liquidation/backstop capacity is established.
pegMechanism: Planned collateralized debt position system: deposit BTC, choose a borrower interest rate and mint BTD. Alpen proposes immutable contracts, no governance and BTC/USD oracle providers fixed at deployment. Exact redemption, liquidation, bad-debt and shutdown rules and oracle/bridge controls remain unverified; BOLD parameters are not inherited as facts.
launchPhaseDetail: Alpen announced BTD on May 8, 2025 as a BTC-only Liquity V2-derived stablecoin intended for immutable deployment on its Bitcoin ZK rollup. Its January 5, 2026 recap reiterates the deposit-BTC, set-interest, mint-BTD design. Alpen launched platform Testnet III on Bitcoin Signet on July 28 for partner integrations; its September 24 USDC/CCTP announcement still makes availability conditional on mainnet launch. These platform milestones do not establish a BTD deployment or token audit. No dated BTD launch window or official token contract is established.

milestones.title: Alpen announces Bitcoin Dollar built from Liquity V2

milestones.title: Alpen recap reiterates BTD design and platform testnets

milestones.title: Alpen launches partner-integration Testnet III on Bitcoin Signet

milestones.description: Alpen says both will be available when mainnet launches. This platform partnership does not announce BTD issuance or a BTD launch date.
